description: Check a whole document in one call: the claims that can be verified against a primary source, each answered by the door that owns it with its own signed receipt, plus one receipt over the document. Extraction is mechanical, so the claim list and the count are reproducible from your document alone — nothing is inferred. This rail answers the first 5 claims for a flat US$0.25 (5 cents a claim); a better-funded document goes to the pack-funded HTTP door (POST /document, up to 25 claims at the same 5 cents a claim), whose free preview lists the claims and the price before anything is charged — use it first if you are unsure the document holds anything checkable. This door reads PROSE: to check a bare list of references or package versions, use verify_bulk, and a single claim belongs to check_figure, check_entity, verify_citation or verify_package. Comes with an Ed25519-signed receipt covering the question, the verdict, the sources and the time, checkable offline against the published key at /.well-known/factstamp-issuer.json — so the check itself can be audited later by someone who was not here.

document.description: The document text. Only sentences that name something we cover AND carry the value to check become claims; everything else is reported as considered.

name: check_document
